definitions.gloss: answer column; answer space; answer box
definitions.explanation: The designated space on a test, exam, or worksheet where students write their answers. A common term in Japanese education.

examples.japanese: {解答欄|かいとうらん}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name in the answer space.

examples.japanese: {解答欄|かいとうらん}からはみ{出|だ}さないように{書|か}くこと。
examples.english: Write so that your answer does not go outside the answer box.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}った{解答欄|かいとうらん}に{答|こた}えを{書|か}いてしまい、{点数|てんすう}がもらえなかった。
examples.english: I wrote my answer in the wrong answer box and didn't get any points.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {解答|かいとう} (answer, solution) and {欄|らん} (column, box, section). Very common in school and exam settings. Test instructions frequently reference the {解答欄|かいとうらん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {解答欄|かいとうらん}に{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in the answer box)
- {解答欄|かいとうらん}に{書|か}く (to write in the answer space)
- {正|ただ}しい{解答欄|かいとうらん} (the correct answer space)

RELATED WORDS:
- {解答用紙|かいとうようし}: answer sheet
- {問題用紙|もんだいようし}: question sheet
